subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain the combined canonical item for tool-result placeholder plus no-reply behavior, or should its evidence be split between https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 and the replay-unsafe incomplete-turn canonical thread?
rationale: Current main fixes the provider placeholder path in part, but source still shows warning/fallback branches whose behavior is policy-sensitive, and related open issues each cover only part of this report.

options.title: Keep combined here
options.body: Track the placeholder conversion and failed-tool no-reply contract together in this issue.

options.title: Split into canonicals
options.body: Move placeholder evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 and fallback evidence to the replay-unsafe incomplete-turn canonical thread before closing this issue.

options.title: Accept current policy
options.body: Treat the remaining warning suppression as intentional, keep only the placeholder canonical open, and close this issue after documenting that choice.

recommendation.title: Keep combined here
recommendation.body: Track the placeholder conversion and failed-tool no-reply contract together in this issue.
